definitions.definition: （一）生成式人工智能技术，是指具有文本、图片、音频、视频等内容生成能力的模型及相关技术。
definitions.english: Generative AI technology means models and related technologies capable of generating content such as text, images, audio and video.

note: Article 22 also defines generative AI service provider and user (Article 22(2), 22(3)), outside the plan's term groups. No English text of the issuer is stored.
